aiItem.title: Less costly worlds
aiItem.text: A nonhidden world could preserve inquiry, fellowship, humility, and confession through science, repair, vulnerability, and exploration. Unless uncertainty enables a unique good outweighing lost relationship, the less costly arrangement dominates by retaining comparable benefits while eliminating sincere ignorance of the divine partner. That additional constraint makes the comparison more precise and publicly assessable.
